description: We are a creative team exploring NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars. Our goal is to tell the stories behind these objects through space research, storytelling, and visual design.
summary:
Our project, “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars,” is an interactive 3D Solar System web application designed to make space exploration history more accessible and engaging.
We developed a platform that allows users to explore the Solar System, discover historic lunar and Mars rovers, and learn about their missions. Using official NASA resources, we transform complex technical information into an interactive educational experience, featuring 3D visualizations of historic rovers such as Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity.
Our project addresses the lack of engaging digital storytelling about historic space exploration equipment and the difficulty of accessing valuable technical archives. By combining interactive technology, scientific data, and storytelling, we aim to inspire the next generation to explore space, discover its history, and appreciate the achievements of humanity beyond Earth.
details:
Our project, “Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA’s Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars,” is an interactive 3D Solar System web application that explores the history of space exploration and tells the stories of equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars.

The project allows users to explore the Solar System and discover historic space equipment, including the Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity rovers. Through 3D visual elements and educational storytelling, we aim to show that space exploration is not only about successful missions and new discoveries, but also about the machines and technology that remain on other worlds.

Our project makes space history more engaging, accessible, and interesting. Instead of presenting information only as text, we combine visual elements with educational content to encourage users to explore and learn. We hope to increase curiosity about space exploration, help people better understand the history of NASA missions, and draw attention to the importance of preserving the legacy of past missions.

We developed our project using HTML and CSS, with Visual Studio Code (VS Code) as our main development environment.

  • HTML was used to create the structure and content of the website.
  • CSS was used to design the interface, organize visual elements, and create the project's cosmic atmosphere.

The creative aspect of our project is its storytelling approach. We focus on equipment that is often overlooked after a mission ends and present its history through an engaging space-themed experience. Our goal is to connect science, technology, history, and visual creativity.

During development, our team considered educational value, visual clarity, accessibility, the importance of accurate historical information, and the need to make the experience interesting for users. We wanted to create a project that not only shares information but also inspires people to look at space exploration from a different perspective.
